name: ruflo-deepseek-harness
description: DeepSeek model harness for ruflo — one-shot deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner (R1) completions via the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Surfaces the reasoner's chain-of-thought (reasoning_content) separately from the final answer; reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and degrades gracefully (exit 0, status:degraded envelope) when the key is unset or the API is unreachable, so ruflo never gains a hard runtime dependency.
